about.bio_p1: Technology has been part of my life for years. Even before starting my training as a developer, I was already experimenting with assembling home servers and configuring my own environments to understand how systems worked on the inside.
about.bio_p2: I am a Higher Technician in Web Application Development, where I have consolidated a solid foundation in Full Stack development, databases, web architecture, and systems integration.
about.bio_p3: Additionally, I am a graduate in Pedagogy. This background directly influences how I work: I have a structured, analytical mindset oriented towards continuous learning. I am interested in understanding processes in depth and building solutions that are clear, maintainable, and well-designed.
about.bio_p4: For years I have also worked with 3D printing. My first printers lacked connectivity, so I configured my own servers using Raspberry Pi to monitor them remotely over WAN. These types of personal projects have reinforced my ability to research, test, document, and solve technical problems autonomously.
about.bio_p5: I have completed training in cybersecurity because I believe development and security must go hand in hand. Many vulnerabilities are born in the programming phase, and as a developer, I am interested in building secure applications from the ground up. Next year I will continue expanding this specialization.
about.bio_p6: I share part of my projects and technical processes on my own channel, which has allowed me to develop documentation and technical communication skills, key abilities for working in a team and transmitting solutions clearly.
about.bio_p7: I define myself as a creative, restless, and persistent person. I like technical challenges and finishing what I start. When something blocks me, I investigate until I understand and solve it. That combination of curiosity and constancy is the engine of my professional evolution.
about.bio_p8: My goal is to continue growing within web development and systems integration, providing real value in projects where technical quality and continuous improvement are a priority.
about.areas_subtitle: Technical capabilities I focus on as a full-stack developer, acquired through academic training, projects, and continuous experimentation.
about.expertise_1_intro: Design and development of web applications with scalable architectures, from the frontend to data persistence. I focus on complete solutions that balance user experience, performance, and code maintainability.
about.expertise_1_cap_1: Frontend architecture with reusable components and state management
about.expertise_1_cap_2: RESTful APIs, authentication (JWT, OAuth) and server-side validation
about.expertise_1_cap_3: Relational modeling, migrations, and query optimization
about.expertise_1_cap_4: Integration of external services and asynchronous error handling
about.expertise_1_cap_5: Testing, debugging and build optimization for production
about.expertise_1_proj_desc: Vocational guidance platform with 3 roles (admin/counselor/student). MVC architecture with Laravel backend, React SPA, authentication with Sanctum and complete CRUD administrative panel.
about.expertise_1_proj_ctx: Final project of the Higher Cycle in Web Application Development
about.expertise_2_intro: Integration of AI models in applications through APIs. Design of structured prompts, rate limit management, and cost optimization. I focus on real use cases that provide value, not on demos without practical application.
about.expertise_2_cap_1: Prompt engineering with dynamic and structured context
about.expertise_2_cap_2: Gemini API integration with streaming and timeout handling
about.expertise_2_cap_3: Error handling strategies, fallbacks, and retry logic
about.expertise_2_cap_4: Cost optimization: response caching and rate limiting
about.expertise_2_cap_5: Data processing: JSON parsing and output sanitization
about.expertise_2_proj_desc: Generation of personalized vocational analysis by sending test results to the Gemini API, processing the structured response, and storing it in the DB. Includes rate limiting and fallback if the API fails.
about.expertise_2_proj_ctx: Practical implementation of generative AI in an educational environment
about.expertise_3_intro: Experience in operating systems, hardware, application deployment, and cloud infrastructure. This technical foundation allows me to diagnose problems from the code to the server, understanding the full stack, not just the application.

about.expertise_3_cap_4: Hardware: fault diagnosis, equipment assembly, server configuration
about.expertise_3_cap_5: Automated deployment with GitHub Actions and Vercel
about.expertise_3_cap_6: Basic monitoring with centralized logs and error tracking
about.expertise_3_proj_desc: Local server with Ubuntu Server running multiple services in Docker containers. NGINX reverse proxy with SSL, resource monitoring, automated backups, and secure remote access via SSH.
about.expertise_3_proj_ctx: Personal laboratory for experimentation with real architectures
